desc:
Byakuren's quote is [**the very first thing she said**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Undefined_Fantastic_Object/Story/Reimu_A's_Scenario#:%7E:text=%E6%B3%95%E3%81%AE%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C%E3%81%AB%E5%85%89%E3%81%8C%E6%BA%80%E3%81%A1%E3%82%8B) when she showed up.

And Miko's quote is the opening line of Prince Shōtoku's [**Seventeen-Article Constitution**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seventeen-article_constitution#:%7E:text=harmony) – as well as the name of [**TD Stage 6**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Ten_Desires/Story/Reimu's_Scenario#:%7E:text=%E5%92%8C%E3%82%92%E4%BB%A5%E3%81%A6%E8%B2%B4%E3%81%97%E3%81%A8%E7%82%BA%E3%81%99).
